headline: Refinery attacks and record diesel prices roil fuels markets
intro: Diesel just hit an all-time record over Labor Day, and now Houthi missiles are turning Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery into a fireball — the kind of one-two punch that makes "the market is underpricing refinery risk" sound less like a hot take and more like a warning label.
overview: Crude and refined product prices are climbing on a wave of supply-side shocks: Houthi missile strikes on Saudi Arabia's Jizan refinery, renewed Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian refineries in Saratov, Perm and Tatarstan, and lingering fallout from the US-Iran strikes are all feeding into a market that TACenergy warns is "underpricing" refinery attack risk. On the ground, US consumers felt it directly — gas and diesel both hit record Labor Day highs, with diesel touching $5.85-5.90/gal in some reports, squeezing freight and food costs. Meanwhile, policy developments continue on the biofuels/SAF front (EPA small refinery exemptions shifting 1.76B RINs, House passage of the Diesel Emissions Reduction Act, record ethanol blending) even as Goldman flags a possible run to $120 oil if Middle East shipping attacks escalate.

stories.title: Attacks On Refineries Are Now 'Shockingly Ordinary', And The Market Is Underpricing The Risk
stories.summary: TACenergy warns energy markets are underpricing refinery attack risk as strikes on refining assets from Iran-related conflict, drones, and missiles become 'shockingly ordinary.'

stories.title: First Visual of Aramco Oil Refinery in Saudi’s Jizan After Houthi Missile Strike; 73 Wounded on Site
stories.summary: A Houthi missile strike reportedly ignited a major fire at Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery, wounding 73 people on site.

stories.title: Ukraine Restarts Attacks on Refineries Deep Inside Russia
stories.summary: Ukraine says it struck oil processing plants in Russia's Perm region and Tatarstan overnight, restarting deep refinery attacks.

stories.title: Ukrainian drones ignite blaze at Russia's Saratov Oil Refinery, locals report
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones ignited a blaze at Rosneft's Saratov refinery, a facility repeatedly targeted in prior strikes.

stories.title: Goldman Flags Risk of $120 Oil
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs flags risk of oil rallying to $120/bbl if Middle East shipping attacks escalate.

stories.title: Oil Prices Hit 3-Month Highs
stories.summary: Oil prices rose to three-month highs Tuesday amid escalating geopolitical supply risks.

stories.title: Gas prices at record high for any Labor Day, as diesel hits all-time record
stories.summary: US gas prices hit a record high for any Labor Day at $4.15/gal, while diesel set a new all-time record of $5.90/gal, per CBS News/AAA data.

stories.title: Gas prices in U.S. hit record Labor Day high, thanks to Iran war and refinery issues
stories.summary: PBS reports gas prices hit a record Labor Day high, driven by the Iran war and refinery issues.

stories.title: Diesel prices reach record $5.85 a gallon, raising cost worries for food and goods
stories.summary: Diesel prices reportedly reached record highs around $5.85/gal, raising cost concerns for food and goods transport.

stories.title: Diesel prices 'going to get worse before better,' creating ripple effect across entire economy, expert says
stories.summary: An industry expert says diesel prices, already at record highs in Houston, are likely to get worse before improving, with ripple effects across the economy.

stories.title: Small Refinery Exemptions Shift RFS Debate
stories.summary: EPA's latest small refinery exemption decisions shifted 1.76 billion RINs, reigniting debate over RFS climate benefits.

stories.title: ATA applauds House committee’s passage of Diesel Emissions Reduction Act
stories.summary: The House Energy and Commerce Committee passed the Diesel Emissions Reduction Act of 2025, a technology-neutral emissions program, sending it to the full House.

stories.title: Record Ethanol Use Helps Lower Fuel Costs, Boosts Farm Demand
stories.summary: US ethanol blending topped 11% as E15/E85 demand grows, a trend proponents say is lowering fuel costs and supporting refiners and farmers.

stories.title: Widow of man who died after Come By Chance refinery fire calls for public inquiry
stories.summary: The widow of a worker killed in the 2022 Come By Chance/Braya Renewable Fuels refinery flash fire is calling for a public inquiry four years after the incident.
